scoringMethodHint.multiplicative: The risk score is likelihood multiplied by impact.
scoringMethodHint.additive: The risk score is likelihood plus impact.
scoringMethodHint.custom: The risk score is calculated by the formula above from likelihood (L), impact (I) and control effectiveness (C).

projectResidualRuleHint.control-reduction: Project risks: the residual score is the inherent score reduced by the project's control evaluation (score × (11 − C) ÷ 10).
projectResidualRuleHint.formula: Project risks: the residual score uses the custom formula with the project's control evaluation as C.

recalculation.next-review: Keep current ratings until each risk's next review

statementFlags.short-event: The event is too short to be clear.
statementFlags.short-consequence: The consequence is too short to be clear.
statementFlags.vague: The statement uses vague words — say what exactly could happen.
statementFlags.cause-equals-event: The cause and the event say the same thing.

dashboard.title: Risk dashboard

register.title: Risk register
